channel.deadlinesDesc: Reminders for insurance, roadworthiness test, service and other deadlines

notify.testBody: If you can read this, scheduled reminders work even when the app is closed.

auth.userShort: The username must be at least 3 characters long.

auth.userNotFound: User not found on this phone.
auth.emailInUse: An account with this email already exists.

auth.tooMany: Too many attempts: try again in a few minutes.
cloud.permissionDenied: Access denied by the server: in the Firebase console, publish the Firestore rules (firestore.rules file).
cloud.noDatabase: The database does not exist: create the Firestore Database in the Firebase console.
cloud.offline: Server unreachable: check your internet connection.
cloud.unauthenticated: Session expired: sign out and sign in again with the online account.

settings.title: Settings
home.emptyHint: Tap "Add" to enter your first vehicle.
home.longPressHint: Long-press a vehicle to move it to a group.
intro.tagline: The deadline notebook for your vehicles
upgrade.bringBody_one: Do you want to copy your vehicle (with deadlines, maintenance and documents) to the online account? The local account stays on this phone anyway.
upgrade.bringBody_other: Do you want to copy your {n} vehicles (with deadlines, maintenance and documents) to the online account? The local account stays on this phone anyway.
upgrade.done: You are now using the online account.
upgrade.doneWith_one: You are now using the online account: 1 vehicle copied.
upgrade.doneWith_other: You are now using the online account: {n} vehicles copied.
upgrade.subtitle: Switch to an online account to share vehicles with other people
login.forgotNeedEmail: First enter your email in the field above.
login.forgotSent: We sent an email to {email} to reset your password.
login.tagline: Your vehicles' deadlines, always under control
login.localInfo: Account saved only on this phone. No sharing.
login.cloudInfo: Lets you share vehicles with other people through groups. Data also stays on the phone.
login.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
login.googleInfo: With Google the app only receives your email address.
login.noCloud: Data stays on this phone. Google sign-in and shared groups will arrive in a future update.
family.title: Shared vehicles
family.needCloud: To share vehicles in a group you need an online account. You can switch without signing out and without losing your vehicles.
family.cloudOff: Online sharing is not yet active in this version of the app.
family.noneHint: Create a group (family, friends, work…) and give the invite code to the others, or join a group with the code you were given.
family.noVehicles: No vehicles in this group yet.
move.needCloud: You need an online account to share a vehicle.
move.addInfo: The vehicle moves to the chosen group and every member will see it and be able to edit it.
move.moveInfo: The vehicle will be removed from "{name}".
move.noGroups: You are not in any group yet
move.noGroupsHint: Create one or join with a code from the Groups tab.
family.codeCopied: Code copied: paste it into WhatsApp or SMS
family.inviteHowTo: The other person installs the app, signs in with an online account, opens the Groups tab → "Join with a code" and enters this code.
family.deleteInfo: All members will lose access to the group's vehicles
family.leaveInfo: You will no longer see this group's vehicles
family.removeBody: {email} will no longer see the vehicles of "{name}".
family.deleteBody: "{name}" will be deleted for all members, together with its vehicles.
family.leaveBody: The vehicles of "{name}" will disappear from this phone.
settings.accountCloud: Online account · data saved on the phone and shared in groups
upgrade.settingsInfo: Share vehicles with other people without signing out: you can bring this account's vehicles with you.
settings.whenNotify: When do you want to be reminded before a deadline?
settings.test1minInfo: Then close the app: if the notification arrives, reminders work
settings.test1minDone: Test reminder scheduled: you can close the app.
settings.batteryHint: On some phones (Xiaomi, Huawei, Samsung, Oppo…) battery saving blocks reminders: in Android Settings → Apps → MyFleetManager → Battery choose "Unrestricted".
settings.pushOkInfo: Tap to copy the device code (needed for a test from the Firebase console)
settings.groupsNeedCloud: To share vehicles in a group, switch to an online account (above, in the Account section).
settings.logoutInfo: Your data stays saved on the phone
settings.blockedInfo: Tap to allow them. If no prompt appears: Android Settings → Apps → MyFleetManager → Notifications → Allow.
settings.inexactInfo: Android may delay reminders. Tap and enable "Alarms & reminders" for MyFleetManager.

doc.notFound: File not found on the phone.
